 Vermont minimum wage is rising in 2027 
 By WCAX News Team Published : Nov. 9, 2026 at 10:38 AM EST | Updated : 31 minutes ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MONTPELIER, Vt. (WCAX) - The minimum wage is going up for Vermonters in 2027.
 The current minimum wage is $14.42 an hour.
 A 49-cent increase will occur Jan. 1 to $14.91 an hour.
 The minimum wage for tipped employees is also going up from $7.21 an hour to $7.46 an hour. 
 If employees don’t receive enough tips to equal the standard minimum wage, their employer pays the difference.
 The changes take effect Jan. 1.
